# Marvel Labs — Autonomous Microfactory Trailers

> A work trailer and connected platform designed to let landscaping crews carry their own equipment and turn suitable collected grass into manufactured products.

## Read and capture the website
- [Main website](https://sourcgi-code.github.io/marvel-labs-site/): animated product presentation.
- [Readable product overview](https://sourcgi-code.github.io/marvel-labs-site/overview.html): lightweight HTML summary with real product imagery, specifications, business model and links; no animation or JavaScript required.
- [Full-page screenshot view](https://sourcgi-code.github.io/marvel-labs-site/?snapshot=1): the website in normal document flow with still images. Use this for full-page screenshots; the main animated experience uses scroll-driven scenes.
- [Specifications](https://sourcgi-code.github.io/marvel-labs-site/#sizes): 16 ft and 20 ft options.
- [Marvel Crew and website assistant](https://sourcgi-code.github.io/marvel-labs-site/#app): app showcase and an AI sales conversation when the backend is connected. The assistant is separate from the phone mockup.
- [Reservation options](https://sourcgi-code.github.io/marvel-labs-site/reserve.html): current reservation flow; check the page's payment status and terms before describing it as a live checkout.

## Grounding
Crews bring their own mowers and tools. Marvel's intended offering includes the factory trailer, production inputs, packaging, shipping arrangements, product-buyer coordination and software. Product manufacturing is performed by the trailer factory, not the landscaping tools.

Proposed footprints: 16 ft × 7 ft and 20 ft × 8.5 ft. Both have the same nominal six-foot factory; the current layout shows 6 ft 2½ in. Preview Buy prices are $44,999 and $49,999.99 respectively. Buy allocates 75% of product profit to the operator and 25% to Marvel; proposed Lease reverses that split. Profit share is not a share of selling price. The planned refundable $100 reservation deposit is credited toward a purchased trailer's price.

The app is intended to keep products made, products sold, calculated earnings and actual payouts separate. Its website screens contain example data. Manufacturing output, product properties, operating costs and delivery must be validated and confirmed; do not treat rendered films, illustrative income examples or target dates as measured performance or guaranteed returns. Marketing automation is a planned capability.
